title: Tech Note: Using LDAP with 4D part II

historical_commentary.text: LDAP remains a still-relevant, widely used directory-service protocol today (e.g., via Active Directory), so the core integration goal of this note is still valid, though modern 4D applications would typically use later, more capable LDAP-related commands and libraries, or delegate authentication to modern identity providers (SSO/OAuth) rather than raw LDAP binds.
related_updates: LDAP directory services remain in wide enterprise use today, though many modern applications now favor SSO/OAuth-based identity providers over direct LDAP binds
